anonymity_rule: Do not infer or seek identities, model families, effort levels, earlier drafts, or earlier review outcomes. Review only the supplied evidence.
learner_baseline: The current learner is an ungrounded, unembodied 1.2B model. Assume zero bankable semantics, grammar, discourse, world knowledge, identity grounding, common sense, interface convention, or human childhood experience.

lesson_context.point: Actual Lesson 000 staged bootstrap: greeting, copular self-identification, affirmative and negative identity, Who, OR, and meeting reciprocity in the original gated order.
lesson_context.world_objective: The names Ninereeds, Taro, Emma, Bob, and Errol remain stable across the source presentation and its noncanonical drills.
lesson_context.structural_exception: L000 is the sole staged nonlexical exception and has zero vocabulary items.

review_requirements: Inspect the exact script, every presentation turn, controlled pool, mixed order, story page/turn, answer contract, comprehension control, intervention, budget, alarm, and asset usage.
Inspect exact image files when a visual judgment is material; do not rely only on declared pixel results.
Judge all learner-facing language and speaker/interface conventions against the zero-knowledge baseline.
Check complete presentation; isolated affirmative, negative, W, OR, and L000 reciprocity gates; mixed practice; coherent picture book; story-dependent comprehension; and honest recap.
Check every scored first-person learner response identifies Ninereeds as Ninereeds.
Check that each modeled turn temporally binds exactly the current speaker while preserving the full relational scene.
Check relation-operand completeness and transformation necessity. Zero crops is correct unless a specific unresolved salience problem requires one.
Check TRAIN_MORE and TRAIN_LONGER resolve only to frozen material with executable release, ordering, budget, stop, and exhaustion rules.
Return revise for any non-waterproof defect. Name exact failures and owning-stage repairs; do not rewrite the lesson.
output_contract: Write exactly one JSON file matching ninereeds_sol_assembly_review_v1. Set lesson_sha256 to candidate_sha256 and visual_necessity explicitly.
